description: This file defines the interface ThreadSafeDittoLogger, an extension of SLF4J Logger with additional methods for managing correlation IDs in logging, including setting, deriving, obtaining, and discarding correlation IDs, with thread safety considerations.

classes.name: ThreadSafeDittoLogger
classes.description: An interface extending SLF4J Logger with additional thread-safe methods for managing correlation IDs in logging.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets a specific correlation ID for log operations, returning a new logger instance with the correlation ID included.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Derives a correlation ID from WithDittoHeaders and returns a logger with that ID, discarding if no valid ID is found.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Obtains a correlation ID from DittoHeaders and returns a logger with that ID, discarding if no valid ID is found.

methods.name: discardCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes the current correlation ID from the logger, resulting in log operations without a correlation ID.
